description: This file defines the Address model class for the Opencart e-commerce system, responsible for managing customer address data in the database. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving addresses, and interacts with other localisation models to obtain address formatting details.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Model class for handling customer address data, including CRUD operations and address retrieval with associated localisation data.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address record in the database for a specific customer, and updates the default address if applicable.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address record for a customer, and resets other addresses' default status if the updated address is set as default.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address records for a customer; can delete a specific address or all addresses associated with the customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed address data for a specific address of a customer, including localisation info such as country and zone.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a customer, enriching each with localisation details.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total count of addresses associated with a customer.
